M1.reason: Every one of the six views and the four angles has the original's outline. Overlap is 0.968 to 0.981, and no part sticks out or is missing in the stills. The vest and arms sit inside the outline in the side and back views.

M2.reason: Measured size is 22.7 x 30.2 x 75.4 against the original's 22.8 x 30.2 x 75.3, well within 10% on all three axes.

M3.reason: The parts are all there in the right number and place: the black vest with shoulder straps, the gold badge on the left chest, the SECURITY lettering on the back, the holster on the right hip, the helmet with its visor band, sleeves, hands, trousers, and the laced boots. Shapes match in every view. The helmet's shading is a colour matter, scored under M4.

M4.reason: The measured colour difference (5.8 mean, every view under 9) is under 15, but the measure is weak on the face. In the front, front-left and front-right views the reproduction's skin is darker, greyer and smudged compared with the original's tan, and the trousers show blotchy patches the original does not. Both are visible at the game's scale. The face is a small region, so the mean understates it.

M5.reason: The panel lines, the badge and the SECURITY lettering are present and in place, but softer. The face's features (eyes, nose, mouth, cheek shading) are blurred and muddy where the original is crisp, and the lettering is less sharp on the back. Clearly off, not missing.

M6.reason: At the game's size the reproduction reads as the same character in the stills. A player comparing them would see the darker, smudged face and, in the run, a vest that does not look like the original's. Taking it for the original is not safe. The line-up is separate and not scored here.

M7.reason: The front faces the original's front in every view, the body is upright, and the feet stand on the same ground line in the side and front views.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. Triangles are 700 against 785, under twice the original's. Static views show nothing open, inside out or floating. The floating vest in the run is scored under C1, not here.

C1.reason: In the run frames (22 reproduction frames against the original's 15, so the cycles differ) the reproduction's vest and holster ride off the back and float clear of the torso in several frames (3/22, 9/22, 13/22, 16/22), while the original's vest stays on the body. Nothing comes apart outright, and the arms and legs move plausibly. No attack or walk was drawn, so only the run is judged.
